# PubliX Group

> PubliX Group is a Nordic buy-and-build group for founder-led SaaS companies that serve the public sector in the Nordics and the UK. It is a permanent owner, backed by Aspira Partners, and headquartered in Stockholm.

PubliX Group AB (org. no. 559485-5487) acquires and develops vertical SaaS companies serving public services, such as social care, grants management, procurement, safety and scheduling. Portfolio companies keep their own brand, office and decision-making; the group adds shared customer relationships, procurement capability, embedded AI expertise and expansion into new markets. The site is written for founders and CEOs considering a partnership or a sale.

Every page is also available as Markdown: replace `.html` with `.md` (`/` → `/index.md`), or request the page with `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Main pages

- [PubliX Group — For founders of Nordic public-sector SaaS](https://publixgroup.io/): Growth platform for SaaS founders in Nordic public services. Scale through shared customers, embedded AI, and expansion into new markets.
- [Why PubliX — The permanent home for public-sector SaaS founders](https://publixgroup.io/why-publix.html): PubliX Group is a permanent owner of Nordic public-sector SaaS companies. No forced exits, shared customers, embedded AI. Why founders choose PubliX.
- [About PubliX Group — Operators building for the public good](https://publixgroup.io/about.html): How PubliX Group works with founder-led SaaS companies serving the Nordic public sector: thesis, value model, and the team.
- [Our Team](https://publixgroup.io/team.html): Meet the team behind PubliX Group: the operators, founders and board members building the growth platform for SaaS companies in public services.
- [Our Companies — PubliX Group Portfolio](https://publixgroup.io/companies.html): The seven founder-led SaaS companies in the PubliX Group portfolio, building essential software for public services in the Nordics and the UK.
- [News](https://publixgroup.io/news.html): The latest news from PubliX Group: acquisitions, partnerships and milestones as we build the leading public-sector SaaS platform in the Nordics.
- [Contact](https://publixgroup.io/contact.html): Get in touch with PubliX Group. Reach Alexander Hübel, CEO, for confidential conversations about your SaaS company. Stockholm office: Kungsgatan 37.

## News

- [PubliX Group acquires Elected Technologies, maker of Caseworker, and enters the UK](https://publixgroup.io/news/elected-technologies.html): Elected Technologies, whose Caseworker system is used in 16 parliaments, becomes the seventh company in PubliX Group and its first outside the Nordics. Simon McIntyre stays on as CEO.
- [PubliX Group enters Denmark and welcomes Bleau A/S](https://publixgroup.io/news/bleau.html): Bleau, the Danish company behind moliri, becomes the sixth company in PubliX Group and its first in Denmark. Same name, same team, same product plan.
- [Sotender launches in Sweden: Suomikoti is first customer](https://publixgroup.io/news/sotender-launches-sweden-suomikoti.html): Finnish SaaS platform Sotender enters the Swedish market. Suomikoti, a Finnish-speaking care home in Enskede with 53 residents, becomes the first Swedish customer.
- [PubliX Group appoints Alexander Hübel as CEO](https://publixgroup.io/news/publix-group-appoints-alexander-hubel-as-ceo.html): Alexander Hübel has been appointed Group CEO of PubliX Group, bringing experience in scaling Nordic technology platforms.
- [PubliX Group partners with Embrace Safety](https://publixgroup.io/news/embrace-safety.html): A powerful SaaS platform enabling knowledge-based crime prevention and safety promotion for municipalities and local authorities.
- [PubliX Group partners with Koivu Solutions (Sotender)](https://publixgroup.io/news/koivu-solutions-sotender.html): A modern SaaS solution for connecting healthcare workers with open shifts, increasing reach and reducing costs for healthcare providers.
- [PubliX Group enters Finland through partnership with Aspicore](https://publixgroup.io/news/aspicore.html): A full-service software provider within grant management, marking PubliX Group's expansion into the Finnish market.
- [PubliX Group partners with digiPlant](https://publixgroup.io/news/digiplant.html): A market leader within application management systems for foundations, strengthening PubliX's position in the grant management vertical.
- [PubliX Group welcomes Tidvis](https://publixgroup.io/news/tidvis.html): Strengthening digital care solutions in the Nordics: Tidvis develops platforms for social services, helping municipalities manage case work and compliance.
